EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. :Bal/2/1/4/05. Land Ministry’s No. : LD/05/2002/PC/244.

I, hereby give Notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose:- Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired:

Land called Welabodawatta, Delgahawatta and Maradanewatta - Kanaththe Delgahawatta acquisition for road widening (near by DEVATA ROAD RANASINGA), EXTENT ABOUT 0.0397 Hectare, depicted as Lots 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 in Surveyor General’s Advanced Tracing Number 4171 and 18.09.2017 dated and situated in 88A, Kandegoda Grama Niladharis Division in Balapitiya Divisional Secretary’s Division in Galle District.
01. Lot No. 1 — Welabodawatta — Hectare 0.0086

North: Devata Road and Canal; East: Canal and Lot No. 02; South: Lot 02, Welabodawatta Claimed by P. Sampath Ranasinga and Welabodawatta Claimed by P. Lasantha Ranasinga; West: Welabodawatta Claimed by P. Lasantha Ranasinga and Devata Road.
02. Lot No. 2 — Welabodawatta — 0.0091 Hectare

North: Lot No. 1 and Canal; East: Canal and Lot No. 03; South: Lot 03, Delgahawatta claimed by Kosama Thanusha Damayanthi and Welabodawatta claimed by P. Sampath Ranasinga; West: Welabodawatta claimed by P. Sampath Ranasinga, Welabodawatta claimed by P. Ranasinga and Lot No. 1.
03. Lot No. 3 — Delgahawatta — 0.0069 Hectare

North: Lot No. 2 and Canal; East: Canal and Lot No. 04; South: Lot No. 04, Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta Claimed by Amithawali Yasoma De Silva Jasenthuliyana (P.P.A. 483/F126) and Delgahawatta claimed by Thanusha Damayanthi (P. P. A. 483/F126); West: Delgahawatta claimed by Kosama Thanusha Damayanthi (P. P. A. 483/F126), Welabodawatta claimed by P. Sampath Ranasinga and Lot No. 2.
04. Lot No. 4 — Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta — 0.0069 Hectare

North: Lot No. 3 and Canal (P.P.A. 483/F126); East: Canal (P.P.A. 483/F126) and Lot No. 05; South: Lot 05, Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta claimed by Jasenthuliyana Anil Hemasaral Upali (P.P.A. 483/F126) and Maradanewattta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta Claimed by Yasoma De Silva Jasenthuliyana (P.P.A. 483/F126); West: Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta claimed by Amithawali Yasoma De Silva Jasenthuliyana (P.P.A. 483/F126), Delgahawatta Claimed by Kosama Thanusha Damayanthi (P.P.A. 483/F126) and Lot No. 3.

05. Lot No. 5 — Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta — 0.0069 Hectare.

North: Lot No. 4 and Canal (P.P.A. 483/F126); East: Canal (P.P.A. 483/F126) and Margasathi Para; South: Margasathi Para and Maradanewatta alias Kanaththa Delgahawatta Claimed by Jasenthuliyana Anil Hemasaral Upali (P.P.A. 483/F126); West: Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta Claimed by Jasenthuliyana Anil Hemasaral Upali (P.P.A. 483/F126) , Maradanewatta alias Kanathatha Delgahawatta claimed by Amithawali Yasoma De Silva Jasenthuliyana (P.P.A. 483/F126) , Lot No. 4.
All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired* are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing

before me at the Divisional Secretariat Office, on the 14th Day of September, 2017 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 07th Day of September, 2017 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of the compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
B. P. S. ANURADHI, Divisional Secretary, Balapitiya.
Divisional Secretariat, Balapitiya, 24th May, 2017.
